title: Cartographer
tagline: Close a square. Claim the land.
blurb: Rival mapmakers ink borders by candlelight. Every square you close blooms into a piece of a hidden map.
description: Dots and boxes on a sheet of parchment. Take turns inking a border between two dots; close the fourth side of a square and it's yours, painted in with the coast, forest, mountains or sea serpent hidden beneath, and you ink again. The finished sheet is a map, coloured in two inks. Three chart sizes, hotseat for two, or play Mercator, a rival who understands chains and the double-cross.
